findings.source_quote: “paring off the amphibologisms [ambiguities] into which they have been led”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “שאליהן הובילו אותנו” with “שאליהן הם נקלעו” to preserve that the evangelists were led into the ambiguities.
findings.translation_quote: “תוך הסרת העמימויות [המשמעויות הכפולות] שאליהן הובילו אותנו”
